description: This file defines an immutable data class 'MeetingData' in the org.apache.fineract.portfolio.meeting.data package. It models the data related to a meeting, including attendees, date, and associated metadata, with various static factory methods for creating instances in different states.

classes.name: MeetingData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a Meeting, with fields for ID, date, attendance, clients, calendar info, and attendance options, along with static factory methods.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a MeetingData instance with only ID and date set; other collections are null.

methods.name: withClientsAttendanceAndAttendanceTypeOptions
methods.description: Creates a MeetingData instance by updating attendance data and options on an existing MeetingData object.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template MeetingData object with specified clients, calendar, and attendance options; other fields are null.

methods.name: withAttendanceTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a new MeetingData object with updated attendance type options.

methods.name: getMeetingDate
methods.description: Getter method for the meeting date.
